notes: MAPGEN-018R: the residuals in the reconstructed_* columns describe how well a model fits a grid RECONSTRUCTED from six meridian and three parallel border observations. They are NOT a geographic holdout accuracy and must never be quoted as one. Independent feature checks on 5 identified towns give a median of 9.3 km and a maximum of 28.6 km, which is what this sheet's placement actually supports.
